from loader import load
from defaults import DEFAULTS
import copy

def test_no_defaults_mutation():
    initial_defaults = copy.deepcopy(DEFAULTS)
    load({"APP_PORT": "9000", "APP_DEBUG": "true", "APP_WORKERS": "4", "APP_NAME": "testapp"})
    assert DEFAULTS == initial_defaults

def test_consecutive_requests_isolation():
    res1 = load({"APP_PORT": "9000"})
    assert res1["port"] == 9000
    
    res2 = load({})
    assert res2["port"] == 8080
    assert res2 is not res1

def test_boolean_conversion():
    assert load({"APP_DEBUG": "true"})["debug"] is True
    assert load({"APP_DEBUG": "False"})["debug"] is False
    assert load({"APP_DEBUG": "1"})["debug"] is True
    assert load({"APP_DEBUG": "0"})["debug"] is False
